label: vectors-n3-10y
_why: THE FOUR TICK-COST VECTORS IN EVERY COMBINATION (user-ruled 2026-10-09: "test it alone and in (all possible) combination(s) with other vector(s), n=3"; 12 arms x n=3, 1836 -> 1846, plus vanilla). Base: the jex book (config/mod_config.perf-full.json = e1a12-ai1135-tex1140-jex-artmerge). V1 = dams as FOUR building types (small/large x cheap/dear, median splits of MW per part and points per MW; small need electrical_generation, large steam_turbine) capped by resource SLOTS in the state regions (capped_by_resources; capped_resources in whole-file copies of map_data/state_regions) in place of 144 types + 144 base_values caps. V2 = the research first stages placed by on_acquired_technology + the campaign start (no is_shown_when_inactive). V3 = production entries in TWO 3-year stages at 0.75 of the era cost each (same total as three 2-year stages at 0.5); war entries unchanged. V4 = one entry per industry for the ladder technologies, bar-fill then retarget (24-month fills, 0.5 each, at most 3 per technology); war and extra entries stay per technology. V3 and V4 are alternative stage structures, hence V1 on/off x {base, V3, V4} x V2 on/off. Setup names v<codes>: v0 = the base book, v124 = V1+V2+V4. Rounds shuffled (seed 7) so no arm always runs first. Read with tools/testbed/ledger/arm_tick_cost.mjs <session> --from 1836 --to 1846, and the research completions per stage (PMR_JE lines) to confirm each vector works.

_predictions.V1: -2 to -2.5 s/yr (F220: the 141 extra building types ~1.4, the caps ~1)
_predictions.V2: -0.5 to -1 s/yr (the 68 first-stage types carrying is_shown_when_inactive, F220 ~0.8)
_predictions.V3: part of the active stage-2/3 cost (F220: one stage instead of three -2.2): -0.5 to -1.5
_predictions.V4: fewer entry types and fewer active entries: -1 to -2
_predictions.combined_best: V1+V2 with V3 or V4: -3 to -5 s/yr of the base book +6.5

_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 (L30); -NoSaveHarvest -NoRedFlagFeed. Never tail -F session.log (L29).

V1 changes the dams economy (535 slots against 312 levels, banded costs) and V3/V4 change research timing; in 1836-46 dams are not reached and research only begins to differ, so the arms compare cost.
No stop watcher, no register reading: a timing probe.
